headline: The garden bites back
lede: CENTIPEDE learned bug-vs-bug in one never-dry stage: the spider now chews through the centipede column and the scorpion's path races segments red — an ecosystem where free kills exist but pay nothing, shipped fully proven.

notes.text: Spider devours segments: the chain re-heads, the rear takes the split boost, and the lunch leaves no mushroom and banks no points — eaten is not shot. Scorpion touches race segments with the same venom law the caps obey. Dice-free, so every seed still replays bit-exact.

Proof: centipedadrive 27/27 in real Chrome (bites banked live, heads grew, score stayed honest) and centipedechek 183/0 with all 41 mutants dead — the same shift slot b shipped ASTEROIDS' kiting bounty dance.

The mutant walk earned its keep: the new bite loop re-used the split-boost line verbatim, which made an old whole-source pin ambiguous and let one mutant live (39/40). Every law now pins to its own loop body, and every new law got its own mutant.
Natural bites are rare before wave 3, and the chomp lacks a visual tell — QA pass #3733 owns the crunch animation, the sting flash, and an authored debris shape.

look.text: See the spider eat the column — and feel how free kills still hurt
ASTEROIDS: the saucer bounty now pays the pilot who kites it
